svg.title: Seen-sentence error against dev error, small and large training sets
svg.desc: Schematic. With a small training set the error on sentences seen in training is near zero while dev error is high (overfitting). With a large training pool the error on seen sentences stays close to dev error (under-fitting). Bar heights are not measured values.
svg.text: Seen-sentence error vs dev error (schematic, lower is better)
seen error near zero, dev error far higher
Large training pool (8 to 26 passes per sentence)
seen error stays close to dev error
under-fitting: points to the frozen encoder
Schematic of the pattern in docs/limitations.md. Bar heights are illustrative, not measured values.
